case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Appellant and brother Benny Joseph were both indicted, so two accused.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant is male; the judgment refers to him as husband of the deceased.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the appellant.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Former police constable; resigned from police service in 1997 and went to Saudi Arabia
accused_occupation.quote: The appellant was a police constable at the time of marriage
accused_occupation.reason: He was a constable at marriage, but he resigned in 1997 and was abroad before the offence.

accused_socioeconomic_status.correct_value: Financially distressed; claimed he went abroad due to financial distress and stringency (1997)
accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: being compelled by financial distress and with the consent and approval of the deceased
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Judgment does mention financial distress as the appellant's reason for going abroad.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Neena is the appellant's wife, a female.

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the deceased.

victim_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused is the deceased's husband, so spouse is correct.

offence_category.reason: Offence charged and convicted at trial is murder under s.302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charges were under Sections 498A/302 read with Section 34 IPC.

weapon.correct_value: Nylon/plastic rope (strangulation) and saree (ligature); knife used to cut saree
weapon.quote: strangulated her by using a plastic rope and then hanged her from a hook of the roof
weapon.reason: Judgment identifies a rope and saree as the means used, and a knife was used to cut the saree.

evidence_type.reason: The judgment repeatedly describes the evidence as circumstantial; there was no eyewitness.

confession.reason: No confession by the appellant is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No sentencing aggravating circumstances are identified in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No sentencing mitigating circumstances are identified in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted appellant under s.302 IPC and imposed life imprisonment and fine.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court sustained the s.302 conviction, dismissing the appeal (Criminal Appeal No. 668 of 2008)
high_court_outcome.quote: The appellant failed to secure his acquittal before the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court affirmed the conviction; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeal and set aside conviction, so appellant is acquitted.

offence_finally_established.reason: The Supreme Court held the circumstantial evidence insufficient, so no offence was established.

imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence was set aside, so no imprisonment remains.

imprisonment_years.reason: Trial sentence was life imprisonment, not a term in years.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs. 10000 was set aside with the conviction; null is consistent with final outcome.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Appellant, a former police constable, and his brother were tried for murder of his wife. Appellant convicted at trial; the brother was acquitted. Witnesses found the wife hanging. Medical evidence did not clearly establish homicide.
neutral_facts.quote: The accused and his brother were acquitted by the trial court and the High Court
neutral_facts.reason: Trial court convicted the appellant and High Court sustained it; only the brother was acquitted. Summary also reveals the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Trial court imposed life imprisonment and fine of Rs. 10000/-.

attempt_completion.reason: Death occurred, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: Wife found hanging with movements; later declared dead; post-mortem showed neck abrasion, hyoid fracture, facial and forehead injuries
physical_harm.quote: Apart from pressure abrasion on the neck and fracture of the greater horn of hyoid bone
physical_harm.reason: Correct on hanging and death, but omits the post-mortem injuries documented by the doctor.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two charges (s.498A and s.302 IPC r/w s.34); s.498A acquitted; s.302 conviction later set aside
number_of_offences.quote: the appellant along with his brother Benny Joseph, were indicted under Sections 498A/Section 302 IPC read with Section 34 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Two charges were framed, but the s.302 conviction was ultimately set aside, so 'one upheld' is misleading.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property offence or financial loss is involved in the case.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Prosecution alleged the appellant plotted to eliminate the deceased; court made no finding on premeditation
premeditation_planning.quote: the appellant plotted to eliminate the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Court did not address premeditation, but the value omits the prosecution's plotting allegation.

motive.correct_value: Prosecution alleged appellant wanted to eliminate wife to legalise his extra-marital relationship with Darly/Anna
motive.quote: in order to legalise the relationship, the appellant plotted to eliminate the deceased
motive.reason: The judgment identifies the prosecution's alleged motive of legalising the extra-marital relationship.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Court accepted authenticity of deceased's letters and remittance records as unimpeached; unchallenged doctor's testimony showed no definite homicidal hanging
key_evidence_accepted.quote: The authenticity of these letters and also of the records relied upon by the defence ... has not been impeached.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Value describes the court's conclusion rather than evidence it accepted; the letters and records were the accepted evidence.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Trial and High Court rejected DW1 (appellant's son Akhil) as untrustworthy; Supreme Court held that reasoning could not be accepted
witness_credibility.quote: His testimony was discarded as not of a prudent son otherwise expected to be sensitive to the death of his mother.
witness_credibility.reason: Value names the wrong witness and reverses the holding: the courts disbelieved DW1, and the Supreme Court accepted him.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Appellant's conduct was somewhat unusual and disoriented; High Court faulted him for not rushing home and arranging his brother's conveyance; Supreme Court found this not conclusive
post_offence_conduct.quote: Though the conduct and the movements of the appellant prior thereto had been somewhat unusual and disoriented
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment discusses the appellant's post-incident conduct in detail, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated; only an order to release if not required elsewhere.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence date 19.9.2000; trial judgment date not stated; High Court judgment dated 21.11.2012; Supreme Court decision 3 October 2016
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment and Order dated 21.11.2012 of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: The High Court judgment date is stated in the judgment but recorded as 'Not stated'.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondents match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.reason: FIR lodged, charge-sheet laid, and case committed to trial, as described.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Prosecution witnesses PW1, PW6 and PW7 re-examined about four years later (22.1.2004), on the eve of charge-sheet; defence alleged tailoring
procedural_irregularity.quote: the last being on 22.1.2004 on the eve of submission of the charge-sheet
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment records the delayed re-recording of witness statements and the defence's allegation of tailoring.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmance, and Supreme Court allowing appeal are all accurately stated.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the prosecution's strangulation, hanging, resignation and deserted-wife arguments in the judgment.

defence_argument.correct_value: Appellant was pushed down on the way home and was not present; defence contended the death was suicide; medical evidence did not establish homicide; circumstantial evidence insufficient
defence_argument.quote: Asserting that the evidence as a whole does unmistakably demonstrate that the deceased had committed suicide
defence_argument.reason: Value omits the defence's central suicide contention.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Suspicion cannot replace proof and benefit of doubt principles match paragraph 53.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: The four cited precedents and citations match those in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Not stated (judgment gives no sentencing reasoning; conviction and life sentence set aside on evidentiary grounds)
sentencing_rationale.quote: conviction and sentence recorded by the courts below is hereby set aside
sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no sentencing rationale; the value wrongly frames the sentence as imposed for a stated reason.

judicial_mitigating_factors.correct_value: Not stated (absence of direct evidence, co-accused's acquittal and inconclusive medical evidence were acquittal grounds, not sentencing mitigation)
judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: The circumstances brought forth by the prosecution do not rule out in absolute terms the hypothesis of the innocence of the appellant.
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Listed grounds are evidentiary reasons for acquittal, not mitigating factors the court weighed in sentencing.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are identified by the court.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Appellant to be released from jail forthwith if not required in any other case
other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant be released from the jail forthwith if he is not required in any other case.
other_sentence_order.reason: The judgment contains a release order, so 'None' is incorrect.
